title: Apache Log4j2 JNDI remote code execution (Log4Shell)
description: A crafted request header reaches Log4j2's JNDI lookup, letting an unauthenticated caller load and run remote code as the service account.
recommendation: Upgrade log4j-core to 2.17.1 or later. Removing the JndiLookup class is a stopgap, not a fix.
evidence: Payload in the X-Api-Client header triggered an outbound LDAP callback to the test collector.

title: Spring Framework data binding remote code execution (Spring4Shell)
description: Data binding on a JDK 9+ deployment lets an attacker reach the class loader and write a web shell.
evidence: Crafted class.module.classLoader parameter changed the access log pattern, confirming the write primitive.

title: Apache Commons Text interpolation remote code execution (Text4Shell)
description: StringSubstitutor interpolation evaluates script and DNS lookups, so attacker controlled text becomes code execution.
evidence: A ${script:javascript:...} value in a reconciliation import field executed on the batch host.

title: libwebp heap buffer overflow in WebP decoding
description: A malformed WebP image overflows the Huffman table during decode, giving memory corruption in anything rendering the file.
recommendation: Update libwebp to 1.3.2 and rebuild every image handling dependency that vendors it.
evidence: Malformed WebP crashed the image resizer worker with a heap overflow in ReadHuffmanCodes.

title: Windows Print Spooler remote code execution (PrintNightmare)
description: An authenticated user can load a driver through the Print Spooler and gain SYSTEM on the endpoint.
recommendation: Apply the July 2021 cumulative update and restrict Point and Print to administrators.
evidence: Standard user account loaded a driver from a UNC path and obtained a SYSTEM shell on a test laptop.

title: curl SOCKS5 proxy heap buffer overflow
description: An over-long hostname passed through a SOCKS5 proxy handshake overflows the heap in libcurl.
recommendation: Upgrade curl and libcurl to 8.4.0 or later in the gateway image.
evidence: The gateway reaches the acquirer through a SOCKS5 proxy and ships libcurl 8.3.0.

title: OpenSSL X.509 email address punycode buffer overflow
description: A crafted certificate with a punycode email field overflows a stack buffer during name checks.
recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSL to 3.0.7 or later on the concentrator.
evidence: Client certificate validation path links OpenSSL 3.0.5, which is in the affected range.

title: OpenSSL X.509 policy constraints denial of service
description: Processing a certificate with excessive policy constraints consumes disproportionate CPU during validation.
recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSL to 3.1.1 / 3.0.9 and bound policy chain depth at the loader.
evidence: Nightly loader spent over eight seconds validating a crafted certificate from a partner feed.

title: setuptools regular expression denial of service in package parsing
description: A crafted package index page makes setuptools' HTML parser backtrack catastrophically, stalling the build.
recommendation: Upgrade setuptools to 65.5.1 or later in the runner base image.
evidence: A dependency resolution step hung for eleven minutes against a mirrored index page.

title: curl FTP PASV response handling connects to an arbitrary host
description: A malicious FTP server can steer curl's passive-mode data connection to a host of its choosing.
recommendation: Upgrade curl to 7.74.0 or later, and disable passive FTP on the archive job.
evidence: The nightly archive export still uses passive FTP to a third-party retention provider.
